title: Nonempty descriptions force unary inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits and let $x$ be a bit string. If the description assigned to $x$ is nonempty, then every bit of $x$ is $1$; equivalently, $x$ is the string of $|x|$ ones.
hypotheses_covered: The description assigned to $x$ is nonempty
